ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious MSHTA Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning from an "mshta.exe" process, which could be indicative of a malicious HTA script execution

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\mshta\\\.exe$") AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\cmd\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\sh\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bash\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\bitsadmin\\\.exe$")) OR (process_original_file_name = "Cmd\.Exe" OR process_original_file_name = "PowerShell\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "pwsh\.dll" OR process_original_file_name = "wscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "cscript\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "Bash\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe" OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE" OR process_original_file_name = "bitsadmin\.exe")))
